# Chaski-R2 ## What this is A separate research and proposal-only SKU based on `Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B`. The root [training_receipt.json](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-r2/blob/4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1/training_receipt.json) describes bf16 LoRA with r=16 and alpha=32. It does not overwrite [SZLHOLDINGS/chaski](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski) and is separate from [SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-5050](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-5050). ## Evidence and artifact identity Reviewed Hub revision: `4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1`. | Published record | Scope and receipt-reported result | |---|---| | [eval_named_n_generate.json](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-r2/blob/4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1/eval_named_n_generate.json) | Owner-run named-N record, `label=MEASURED`, `gate_ran=true`, JSON drafts 5/5, adversarial refusals 6/6, `publication_eligible=false`; computed 2026-08-29. | | [eval_merged_measured.json](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-r2/blob/4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1/eval_merged_measured.json) | Merged checkpoint, plain Transformers fp16, temperature 0, named PR 63 gates: JSON drafts 5/5 and adversarial refusals 6/6; evaluated `2026-09-14T12:34:01.477237+00:00`. | | [merge_receipt.json](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-r2/blob/4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1/merge_receipt.json) | Repair on 2026-09-14 after the previous merge was an empty base copy. Root adapter applied to that base copy; 96/96 modules touched; maximum weight delta `0.00423942506313324`. | The separate [post-publication gate receipt](https://github.com/szl-holdings/szl-forge/blob/a6b58f623185820eddfb0b279d21b7d81b87137c/frontier/evaluation/gate_runs/chaski-r2_4ef29684c56d_20260915T093042Z_receipt.json) names Hub revision `4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1` and reports **1/5** on the canonical held-out suite in `transformers-cpu` mode, with overall **FAIL**, `heldout_passed=false`, `productionAuthorization=false`, and `publicationAuthorization=false`. This is a different suite from the earlier named-N record; its results cannot be exchanged or combined with those earlier scores. The receipt reports `refusalPassed=true` for the separate refusal check while its embedded held-out object has `refusal_no_regression=false`. Those fields are preserved as reported; neither changes its overall FAIL result. ## What the evidence does and does not establish The **5/5 + 6/6 records are real published measured records**. Their public receipt files do not cryptographically bind those results to one exact public adapter-file SHA-256 or merged-weight revision. The separate later failed gate explicitly names the Hub revision above; this does not retroactively supply the missing binding for the earlier successful records. No third-party benchmark, broad capability estimate, or qualification follows. The older [szl-source-binding.json](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-r2/blob/4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1/szl-source-binding.json) retains `evaluation_state=NONE_THIS_RUN` and `release_blocker=no_json_or_refusal_gate`; the [training_receipt.json](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-r2/blob/4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1/training_receipt.json) and [training_receipt.local.json](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-r2/blob/4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1/training_receipt.local.json) retain `evals=none-this-run`. These historical fields conflict with a present-tense claim that no evaluation records exist. They are preserved as source history, not silently rewritten. Training receipts also describe different runs: [training_receipt.json](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-r2/blob/4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1/training_receipt.json) reports 10 rows and train loss `1.4571`; [training_receipt.local.json](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-r2/blob/4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1/training_receipt.local.json) reports 32 rows and train loss `0.7656`. Train loss is not evaluation. The [adapter-unsloth/training_receipt.json](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-r2/blob/4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1/adapter-unsloth/training_receipt.json) describes a separate subdirectory adapter with r=8 and alpha=16; evidence for the root adapter must not be transferred to it. No single historical adapter digest is asserted here as the current public file identity. The [provenance.json](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-r2/blob/4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1/provenance.json) retains blocked lineage, consent, privacy-review, deployment, and served-revision boundaries. ## Release, autonomy, and deployment boundary `publication_eligible=false` and `autonomy_eligible=false` remain unchanged. Proposal only. No qualification, promotion, deployment authorization, autonomy, house-lab load, or lab approval follows from these records. No tokens-per-second or energy-performance claim is made. Lambda uniqueness remains **Conjecture 1: open and advisory, never a theorem**. ## Relationship and source of truth Chaski-R2 is a sibling of Chaski and Chaski-5050. The [A11OY-MINI](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/A11OY-MINI) R2 GGUF is a separate derived runtime with its own evidence boundary; results do not transfer between adapters, merged checkpoints, and quantizations. Use the immutable evidence links above and the [canonical post-publication gate receipt](https://github.com/szl-holdings/szl-forge/blob/a6b58f623185820eddfb0b279d21b7d81b87137c/frontier/evaluation/gate_runs/chaski-r2_4ef29684c56d_20260915T093042Z_receipt.json) for evaluation claims. The historical source card is [chaski-r2/card/README.md](https://github.com/szl-holdings/szl-forge/blob/a6b58f623185820eddfb0b279d21b7d81b87137c/chaski-r2/card/README.md); its `none-this-run` language and [szl-source-binding.json](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/chaski-r2/blob/4ef29684c56de07626b1cefb4b93a1b486de2aa1/szl-source-binding.json) document a prior publication state, not a current complete evaluation summary.
